texts.Giving_RecurringHealth_Intro: Your monthly recurring revenue and the recurring gifts at risk: a failed charge, a card about to expire, a cancellation at the processor or a payment gone overdue. Processor news arrives as Recurring Gift Events from your Zapier recipe.
texts.Giving_RecurringHealth_TaskCreated: Follow-up task created for you, due today.
texts.Giving_RecurringHealth_Unmatched: {0} processor events match no recurring gift. Open Recurring Gift Events, Unmatched Events, and choose the Commitment for each.
texts.Giving_RecurringHealth_Unexpected: Recurring Donor Health could not do that. The details are in the Error Log.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgment_TemplateNotFound: The email template {0} for rule {1} is missing. Edit the rule on the Thank-Yous page and choose another template.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgments_ErrorReorderNotPe: Changing the order of the rules needs the Manage BarnCRM Settings permission.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgments_Intro: What is waiting to be thanked and the buttons that send it. Emails send from here or overnight. Letters come out as a spreadsheet you merge with your own letter and print.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgments_LettersReady: The letter file is ready on the run below. Merge it, print it, and then choose Mark as Sent.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgments_NoRules: You have no rules yet, so no gift is being queued for a thank you. Add one with New Rule.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgments_NotScheduled: Not scheduled. Nothing goes out until you choose Send Emails Now.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgments_RulesHelp: Rules are considered from the top: the first one that matches a gift decides its thank you. Drag a rule, or use Move Up and Move Down, to change the order.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgments_TemplateFieldHelp: The email this rule sends. The list shows every active email template in your org. To add a template or change its wording, use Setup, under Email Templates.
texts.Giving_AskPipeline_Empty: No open asks yet. Choose New Ask, or add one from a person's or organization's page.
texts.Giving_AskPipeline_Intro: Every open ask by stage. Drag a card to another stage, or use its menu to move, close or reopen it.
texts.Giving_AskPipeline_LinkHelp: Choose a gift or a pledge from this ask's donor.
texts.Giving_AskPipeline_NextAskHelp: When to ask this donor again. Optional.
texts.Giving_AskPipeline_ReopenConfirm: The ask from {0} goes back on the board at {1}. A gift or pledge it recorded stays linked to it.
texts.Giving_AskPipeline_Reopened: The ask from {0} is open again, at {1}.
texts.Giving_CommitmentNew_EndHelp: Fill in one: the number of payments or the date of the last one.
texts.Giving_CommitmentNew_ErrorAmountEachTime: Enter the amount of each payment, above zero.
texts.Giving_CommitmentNew_ErrorLastDate: The last payment date is before the first payment date. Change one of them.
texts.Giving_CommitmentNew_ErrorNoDonor: Choose the donor: a person or an organization.
texts.Giving_CommitmentNew_ErrorRecurringSched: Enter how often the donor gives and the date of the first payment.
texts.Giving_CommitmentNew_ErrorTwoDonors: Choose one donor: a person or an organization, not both.
texts.Giving_CommitmentNew_ErrorUnexpected: The commitment could not be saved, and nothing was changed. The Error Log has the details.
texts.Giving_CommitmentNew_PreviewEmpty: Fill in the amount, how often and the dates to see the payments here before you save.
texts.Giving_CommitmentNew_PreviewPledge: {0} payments of {1}, the last one {2} on {3}.
texts.Giving_CommitmentNew_PreviewRecurring: {0} each time, the first on {1}. More payments are added as they come due.
texts.Giving_Donate_BelowMinimum: A donation page gift was refused: the amount is below the page minimum of {0} (Donation Page Minimum Amount in Settings, Giving section).
texts.Giving_Donate_GoalItem: What we set out to raise
texts.Giving_Donate_NoGift: No gift was written for online payment {0}: the payment or the donor could not be found. Check the Form Submission and the payment, then enter the gift by hand.
texts.Giving_Donate_NoPayments: BarnCRM Payments is not installed, so online gifts cannot be taken.
texts.Giving_Donate_Offline: Online giving for this appeal is not open right now. Contact us to give.
texts.Giving_Donate_TooMany: A donation page gift was refused: this appeal has started 30 checkouts in the last hour, the most allowed, which can be a sign of card testing. Gifts open again as the hour passes.
texts.Giving_DonorLevels_Empty: You have not created any levels yet. Choose New Level to add the first rung of your ladder.
texts.Giving_DonorLevels_Intro: Your giving ladder. Each rung is a name for a group of donors and the amount that reaches it. Donors move onto it automatically as their giving changes.
texts.Giving_DonorPanel_LoadError: The donor summary could not be loaded. You can still enter the gift.
texts.Giving_DonorPanel_NoCommitments: No open pledges or recurring gifts.
texts.Giving_FundSplit_BarHint: Drag a divider on the bar, or select it and press the arrow keys, to move money between two funds.
texts.Giving_FundSplit_DuplicateFund: Each fund can be chosen once. Put all of its amount on one row.
texts.Giving_FundSplit_NeedsAmount: Give every row an amount. A refund's amounts are all below zero, like the refund.
texts.Giving_FundSplit_NeedsFund: Choose a fund on every row, or remove the row.
texts.Giving_FundraisingHome_AppealsHelp: The mailings and campaigns gifts answer, and what each raised.
texts.Giving_FundraisingHome_AsksHelp: Every ask, by donor, amount and stage. Ask Pipeline shows them as a board.
texts.Giving_FundraisingHome_DashboardsHelp: Your organization's dashboards, including the Fundraising dashboard.
texts.Giving_FundraisingHome_DonorLevelsHelp: Your giving ladder: the levels and the amount each one starts at.
texts.Giving_FundraisingHome_DonorSegmentsHelp: Lists of donors by their giving, ready to export for mailings.
texts.Giving_FundraisingHome_FirstRunMessage: No gifts yet. Enter one now, or import a file of past gifts. The figures here fill in as gifts arrive.
texts.Giving_FundraisingHome_FundsHelp: The funds gifts are allocated to, and each fund's total.
texts.Giving_FundraisingHome_InstallmentsHelp: Every scheduled payment on a pledge or recurring gift, paid or due.
texts.Giving_FundraisingHome_LoadError: Fundraising Home could not be loaded. Reload the page. If it keeps happening, the Error Log has the details.
texts.Giving_FundraisingHome_PledgeRemindersHe: Reminders for upcoming and overdue scheduled payments, and what is due to go.
texts.Giving_FundraisingHome_ReceiptsHelp: The receipt letters donors read, and this year's statements.
texts.Giving_FundraisingHome_RecurringDonorHea: Monthly recurring revenue, and the recurring donors who may be about to stop.
texts.Giving_FundraisingHome_StewardshipPlansH: The follow-up plans your organization repeats, and their steps.
texts.Giving_FundraisingHome_TributesHelp: Gifts in honor or memory of someone, and who to notify.
texts.Giving_GiftAllocations_NoDelete: Taking a fund off a gift deletes its allocation, and you do not have delete access to Gift Allocations. Ask your BarnCRM admin to make this change.
texts.Giving_GiftAllocations_None: This gift is not allocated to any fund yet.
texts.Giving_GiftAllocations_Saved: Funds saved. The gift's allocations now match the split.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_CreatedNote: These gifts have been created. Each line links to its gift. To correct a gift, refund or write off that gift.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorAlreadyCreated: The gifts for this batch have already been created. Creating them again would enter every gift twice.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorCreateFailed: No gifts were created. The batch is still here as you left it.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorEditAfterCreate: The gifts for this batch have been created, so its lines can no longer be changed. To correct a gift, refund or write off that gift.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorNoAccess: You can see this batch but not change it or create its gifts. Ask your BarnCRM admin for the Giving Staff permission set, or for edit access to this batch.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorNoControlTotal: Enter the control total from the deposit slip before creating the gifts, so there is something to check against.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorNoRows: This batch has no lines yet, so there are no gifts to create.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorOverControlTotal: This batch does not balance: the lines add up to {0} more than the control total. Look for a line entered twice or a mistyped amount, then choose Create Gifts again.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorRowsIncomplete: Some lines are not finished. Fix the lines marked below, then choose Create Gifts again.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorShortOfControlTota: This batch does not balance: the lines add up to {0} less than the control total. Find the missing gift or correct the control total, then choose Create Gifts again.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_FromBatchHelp: Leave date, payment method, fund or appeal empty and the line uses the batch's.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_NoLinesHelp: Choose Add Line and type the first check.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_UseComputer: Batches are easier on a computer. On a phone, scroll the lines sideways to reach every column, or use Quick Gift Entry for a single gift.
texts.Giving_GiftEntryPays_Help: Payments this donor still owes on active or paused pledges and recurring gifts. Choose one to link the gift to it, or None for a gift on its own.
texts.Giving_GiftEntry_ErrorOneDonor: Choose one donor: a person or an organization, not both.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorBrandAmbiguous: More than one brand is named {0}. Use the brand's record ID instead.
texts.Giving_PayOnline_EmailBody:
Hello {0},

Here is your secure link to pay {1} on {2}:

{3}

The link opens our payment provider''s page, where you enter your card. It works once, for a limited time; if it expires, choose Pay Online in the portal again.

Thank you for your support.
texts.Giving_PayOnline_NoEmail: We have no email address for you, so we can't send a payment link. Contact us to pay.
texts.Giving_PayOnline_NotActive: This pledge or recurring gift is not active, so nothing is due on it.
texts.Giving_PayOnline_NotReady: Paying online isn't available right now. Contact us to pay.
texts.Giving_PayOnline_NotSent: A donor portal payment link was not emailed. The donor can choose Pay Online again; check the org's email deliverability if it repeats.
texts.Giving_PayOnline_NothingDue: Nothing is due on this pledge right now.
texts.Giving_PayOnline_Sent: We've emailed you a secure link to pay. It may take a few minutes to arrive.
texts.Giving_PayOnline_Automatic: This recurring gift is paid automatically. To change the card, choose Update Card.
texts.Giving_AutoPay_EmailBody:
Hello {0},

Here is your secure link to set up automatic payments of {1} on {2}:

{3}

The link opens our payment provider''s page, where you enter your card once; it is then charged each time a payment is due. It works for a limited time; if it expires, choose Pay Online in the portal again.

Thank you for your support.
texts.Giving_UpdateCard_EmailBody:
Hello {0},

Here is your secure link to update the card for {1}:

{2}

The link opens our payment provider''s page, and we never see your card. It works for a limited time; if it expires, choose Update Card in the portal again.

Thank you for your support.
texts.Giving_UpdateCard_EmailSubject: Update the card for your recurring gift
texts.Giving_UpdateCard_NoSubscription: This gift isn't paid automatically, so there is no card to update. Choose Pay Online to pay.
texts.Giving_UpdateCard_Sent: We've emailed you a secure link to update your card. It may take a few minutes to arrive.
texts.Giving_Periods_Intro: Close the books through a date when a month is finished. No gift dated on or before it can be added, or have its date, amount, donor, payment method, reference or funds changed, or be deleted. Refunds and write-offs are dated today, so they still work.
texts.Giving_Periods_ReopenNote: Moving the date back reopens a closed period. It needs the Override Posting Lock permission, granted in Setup, and it is written to the Error Log.
texts.Giving_PledgeReminders_Intro: Reminders for scheduled payments of pledges and recurring gifts that are coming due or overdue. Each step fires a set number of days before or after a payment's due date, by email or letter. Only the latest step due for a payment is sent, and every reminder is logged below.
texts.Giving_PledgeReminders_NoSteps: No steps yet. Add the first step, for example an email 7 days before the due date and another 14 days after.
texts.Giving_PledgeReminders_TemplateFieldHelp: The email template this step sends. Use merge fields from the scheduled payment, such as the due date and the amount, so each donor sees their own.
texts.Giving_PostingCard_ClosedPeriod: Dated in a closed period, so its date, amount, donor, payment method, reference and funds stay locked. The books are closed through
texts.Giving_PostingCard_Unposted: Unposted. The reason is in the Error Log. After your next export, choose Mark These Gifts Posted on the Accounting Export page to post it again.
texts.Giving_QuickGiftEntry_ErrorMatchedGift: Only an organization's gift can match an employee's gift. Choose a gift from the list, or leave it empty.
texts.Giving_QuickGiftEntry_ErrorSplit: A split is for a gift of money: choose a different fund on every row, give each an amount, and make the rows add up to the gift's amount.
texts.Giving_QuickGiftEntry_ErrorTributeType: Choose whether this gift is in honor of someone or in memory of them.
texts.Giving_QuickGiftEntry_FairMarketValueHel: For your reporting only. It is never printed on the receipt and never added into a giving total. Leave it empty if you do not have a figure yet.
texts.Giving_QuickGiftEntry_InKindDescriptionH: This is printed on the donor's receipt word for word. Write what a stranger would recognize a year from now.
texts.Giving_QuickGiftEntry_MatchEmpty: No gift to match yet: nobody whose Employer is this organization has a gift that is not already matched.
texts.Giving_QuickGiftEntry_MatchHelp: Gifts from people whose Employer is this organization, newest first. The employee is recognized on this gift with a soft credit.
texts.Giving_QuickStatus_CancelPendingGift_Con: Cancel this pending gift? It is marked Cancelled, and a scheduled payment it was expected to pay is open again.
texts.Giving_QuickStatus_CancelPendingGift_Not: Only a pending gift can be cancelled. A gift that was received is refunded or written off instead.
texts.Giving_QuickStatus_DoNotThank_Confirm: Take this gift out of the thank-you queue? No thank you is sent for it.
texts.Giving_QuickStatus_DoNotThank_Done: No thank you will be sent for this gift.
texts.Giving_QuickStatus_DoNotThank_NotApplica: This gift is not waiting for a thank you, so there is nothing to skip. To send one, use Thank Again.
texts.Giving_QuickStatus_MarkPlanComplete_Conf: Mark this stewardship plan complete? Its status becomes Complete, with today as its Completed Date.
texts.Giving_QuickStatus_MarkPlanComplete_NotA: This plan is not running, so there is nothing to complete.
texts.Giving_QuickStatus_ReopenAsk_Confirm: Reopen this ask? Its outcome goes back to Open and it returns to its stage on the Ask Pipeline. A gift or pledge it recorded stays linked.
texts.Giving_QuickStatus_ThankAgain_Confirm: Thank this donor again? The gift goes back into the queue on the Thank-Yous page and is sent with the next run.
texts.Giving_QuickStatus_ThankAgain_Done: The gift is back in the thank-you queue.
texts.Giving_QuickStatus_ThankAgain_NotApplica: This gift is already waiting for a thank you on the Thank-Yous page.
texts.Giving_Receipt_LetterheadNote: Your organization's name, address and logo print above this letter on every document. To change them, change your organization and receipt settings, not the letter.
texts.Giving_Receipt_NoRunsMessage: Choose a statement year and select Generate to produce one statement of the year's gifts for each donor.
texts.Giving_Receipt_PreviewNote: This shows the wording with the sentences BarnCRM adds. To check the printed page, issue a receipt for a test gift.
texts.Giving_Receipt_TaxNote: The tax wording is not in this letter and cannot be edited. Whatever you write here, BarnCRM adds the sentences a valid receipt must carry: whether goods or services were provided, the quid pro quo disclosure with its good faith estimate and deductible amount, and the intangible religious benefits sentence.
texts.Giving_Receipt_TokensIntro: Tokens you can use. Type each one exactly as shown, with both pairs of braces:
texts.Giving_Receipt_VoidConfirmMessage: The receipt stays on file as Void and a new one is issued with the next receipt number. This cannot be undone.
texts.Giving_Receipt_VoidNote: The receipt the donor already has is never changed or deleted. Voiding records why, and the replacement takes the next number.
texts.Giving_SchedulePreview_CancelMessage: The {0} unpaid payments are marked Skipped and no more are added. Gifts already received are not touched.
texts.Giving_SchedulePreview_Empty: No payments have been generated for this commitment yet.
texts.Giving_Segments_ChampionsDescription: Donors whose giving pattern is Champion: they gave recently, often and generously.
texts.Giving_Segments_Empty: No segments yet. Save one from a template above, or save a Find query of people or organizations.
texts.Giving_Segments_Intro: Named lists of donors chosen by their giving. Count them, see who is in them, and export a file to import into Mailchimp or Constant Contact. BarnCRM sends nothing.
texts.Giving_Segments_LapsedDescription: Gave last year and nothing yet this year.
texts.Giving_Segments_LevelMoversDescription: Moved from one donor level to another in the last 90 days.
texts.Giving_Segments_MajorProspectsDescriptio: A largest gift of 1,000 or more or total giving of 5,000 or more, and a gift in the last two years.
texts.Giving_Segments_NewDescription: Made a first gift in the last 365 days.
texts.Giving_Segments_SlippingDescription: Donors whose giving pattern is At Risk: they gave often or generously before, but not recently.
texts.Giving_Segments_UpgradersDescription: Gave last year and has already given more this year than all of last year.
texts.Giving_SetupAssistant_FundAppealStepDesc: Pick where a gift goes when nobody says otherwise.
texts.Giving_SetupAssistant_IdentityDescriptio: Record the name, tax identification number, address, logo, and signature that appear on your receipts and letters.
texts.Giving_SetupAssistant_VerifyDescription: Follow the short walkthrough that adds a person, a household, and a first gift, so you know the setup is right.
texts.Giving_SetupNote_Email_What: Let this org send email, so emailed thank yous can go out.
texts.Giving_SetupNote_Email_Why: Salesforce sends no thank you emails unless Deliverability is set to All email, and only Setup can change it.
texts.Giving_SetupNote_FromAddress_Steps: Click Add.|Enter the display name and address, choose who may use it, then click Save.|Open the email Salesforce sends to that address and click its verification link.|Back here, choose the address in Acknowledgments from address.
texts.Giving_SetupNote_FromAddress_What: To send thank yous from a shared address such as giving@yourorg.org, add and verify it as an organization-wide address.
texts.Giving_SetupNote_FromAddress_Why: Salesforce sends from a shared address only once Setup has added and verified it; without one, thank yous come from whoever sends them.
texts.Giving_SetupNote_RecordPages_Steps: Click Edit next to Gift Record Page.|Click Activation, then Assign as Org Default, and save.|Do the same for Giving Contact Record Page and Giving Account Record Page, choosing App Default and the BarnCRM app.
texts.Giving_SetupNote_RecordPages_What: Assign Gift Record Page as the org default for Gift, so every gift shows the Receipts, Soft credits and Tribute panels. To show giving in the BarnCRM app, also assign Giving Contact Record Page and Giving Account Record Page to it.
texts.Giving_SetupNote_RecordPages_Why: Only Setup can assign a record page as a default, for the org or for an app.
texts.Giving_SetupNote_Templates_Steps: In the Folder list, choose BarnCRM Acknowledgments.|Click BarnCRM: thank you for your gift, then Edit, or click New Template to write your own.|Change the wording, then click Save.
texts.Giving_SetupNote_Templates_What: Write or change what an emailed thank you says in an email template. BarnCRM ships one to start from: BarnCRM: thank you for your gift.
texts.Giving_SetupNote_Templates_Why: Salesforce keeps template editing, preview and test sends in its own editor, for everybody.
texts.Giving_SoftCredits_AutomaticHelp: BarnCRM created this credit from the household and keeps it up to date. Change the gift, or who is in the household, and it follows.
texts.Giving_SoftCredits_Empty: Nobody else is recognized for this gift yet.
texts.Giving_SoftCredits_RecomputeDeferred: Salesforce was too busy to update household soft credits for {0} households just now. They catch up the next time each gift is saved.
texts.Giving_SoftCredits_RemoveConfirm: The credit for {0} is removed from this gift. The gift itself does not change.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_Empty: You have not written a plan down yet. Choose New Plan to write the first one.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_FieldMinimumHelp: Only for the two gift events. Leave it empty to start on any gift.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_Intro: The follow-up your organization repeats. Write a plan down once here, and BarnCRM lays its tasks out every time the plan applies.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_RemoveStepConfirm: The step {0} is removed from this plan, so the plan no longer lays out that task.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_NoSteps: This plan has no steps yet, so it would start and lay nothing out. Add the first step.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_SelectPlan: Choose a plan to see and edit its steps.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_StepSubjectHelp: What the assignee reads in their task list. Write it as an instruction: Call to say thank you, not Thank you.
texts.Giving_TributeNotification_Empty: This gift was not given in honor of or in memory of anyone.
texts.Giving_Erase_GiftsKept: Kept with their amounts and dates, credited to the anonymous record, so totals stay right.
texts.Giving_Erase_ReceiptsKept: Kept as tax records. Their PDF documents still print the donor's name and address: delete them by hand once your rules allow it.
texts.Giving_HealthCheck_DonationFormDetail: These active appeals have Donation Page on, but their donation form has no question with the key amount, so their page cannot start a checkout. Add an amount question to the form and publish it, or choose another form in the appeal's Donation Form ID.
texts.Giving_HealthCheck_DonationFormTitle: Donation Forms Without an Amount Question
texts.Giving_HealthCheck_LookupSkewDetail: These funds or appeals each have more than {0} gifts. Every gift saved against one of them briefly locks it, so a large import or gift batch that saves many of their gifts at once can fail with record lock errors. Load those gifts serially or in smaller batches, and spread new gifts across more specific funds or appeals where that suits your reporting.
texts.Giving_HealthCheck_LookupSkewTitle: Funds or Appeals With Very Many Gifts
texts.Giving_HealthCheck_OverrideLockDetail: The Override Receipt Lock permission lets a person change or delete a gift that has a receipt number. BarnCRM grants it to nobody: assign it in Setup for one correction, then remove it. It is held by {0}. If no one is correcting a receipted gift, remove it in Setup, Custom Permissions. Changes made with it are in the Error Log.
texts.Giving_HealthCheck_ReceiptFailedManyDeta: {0} receipts are Void with the reason Generation failed, so those donors are still waiting for their documents. Read the receipt entries in the Error Log, fix what they name, and run the receipts again. Leave the void records alone: they account for the numbers that were used.
texts.Giving_HealthCheck_ReceiptFailedOneDetai: One receipt is Void with the reason Generation failed. That is a number handed to a document that never generated. A single one is ordinary, not a problem. The Error Log says what went wrong, and the receipt can be run again once it is fixed.
texts.Giving_HealthCheck_UnpostedClosedPeriodD: These gifts are locked because their date is on or before Books Closed Through, but none is marked posted to accounting. If they belong in an export you already sent, mark them posted on the Accounting Export page (Mirror). If not, move Books Closed Through back (needs the Override Posting Lock permission).
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorAmountNotPositive: The amount must be more than zero.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorAmountUnreadable: The amount {0} is not a number BarnCRM can read.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorAppealAmbiguous: More than one appeal is named {0}.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorCannotDeleteGifts: A gift import needs permission to delete gifts, because it removes a gift it could not finish. Ask your BarnCRM admin for the Giving Admin permission set.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorCustomRoleMissing: A soft credit with the role Other needs Soft credit: custom role.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorDateUnreadable: The date {0} cannot be read. Write it as 2026-03-15, or the way your Salesforce locale shows dates.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorDonorChoice: Gift: donor must be Contact1, Organization or Household, not {0}.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorDonorHouseholdMissing: Gift: donor says the household gave the gift, and the row has no household.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorDonorOrganizationMiss: Gift: donor says the organization gave the gift, and the row has no organization.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorDonorPersonMissing: Gift: donor says the first person gave the gift, and the row has no first person.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorExternalIdRepeated: Gift: external ID {0} names a gift that already exists, and this template never matches.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorFailed: The gift could not be saved: {0}
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorFundAmbiguous: More than one fund is named {0}. Use its accounting code instead.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorFundNotFound: No fund is named {0}, or has it as its accounting code.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorInKindAmount: An in-kind gift has no amount. Leave Gift: amount empty or 0, and put what the goods were worth in Gift: fair market value.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorMatchOnlyNone: Gift: this template only pays scheduled payments, and no open payment of this donor is due near this date for this amount.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorMatchTie: Gift: two scheduled payments are equally close to this gift, {0} and {1}. Link it to one by hand, or give the row an external ID of an existing gift.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorNeverMatchInstallment: Gift: this gift matches the scheduled payment {0}, and this template never matches.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorNoDonor: The row names nobody to give the gift: map a person or an organization.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorNotAttempted: Not attempted: this chunk ran out of room before this gift could be finished. Load this row again.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorPartsWithoutGift: The row has fund, soft credit or tribute columns but no gift amount, so there is nothing to allocate or credit.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorSoftCreditPartyChoice: Soft credit: credit whom must be Contact1, Contact2, Organization or Household, not {0}.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorSoftCreditPartyMissin: The soft credit names nobody the row has: map a second person, or say in Soft credit: credit whom who to credit.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorSoftCreditRoleUnknown: The soft credit role {0} is not one BarnCRM knows. Use one of: {1}.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorSplitAmountsDiffer: The split adds up to {0}, not the gift amount of {1}.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorSplitMixed: A split gives every part as an amount, or every part as a percent, not a mix.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorSplitPartIncomplete: Part {0} of the split needs a fund and either an amount or a percent, not both.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorSplitPercentsDiffer: The split percents add up to {0}, not 100.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorTributeHonoreeMissing: A tribute needs Tribute: honoree name.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorTributeTypeUnknown: The tribute type {0} is not one BarnCRM knows. Use one of: {1}.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorTypeMissing: The gift has no payment method. Map a column to it, or give the template a default payment method.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorTypeUnknown: The payment method {0} is not one BarnCRM knows. Use one of: {1}.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorValueUnreadable: The value {0} in {1} cannot be read.
texts.Giving_Import_LogAttributesNotLoaded: These gift columns name no gift field the import may write, and were not loaded: {0}.
texts.Giving_Import_LogPaymentsMatched: Gifts that pay a scheduled payment: {0}.
texts.Giving_Import_UndoKeptClosedPeriod: Kept: this gift is dated in a closed accounting period. If it was a mistake, record a refund: it is dated today.
texts.Giving_Import_UndoKeptDonor: Kept: a gift this import made, which the undo is keeping, still names this record.
texts.Giving_Import_UndoKeptPosted: Kept: this gift is posted to accounting. If it was a mistake, record a refund, or ask your bookkeeper to unpost it first.
texts.Giving_Import_UndoKeptReceipted: Kept: a receipt lists this gift, and the donor holds it. Void the receipt, then refund or write off the gift, if it was a mistake.
texts.Giving_Import_UndoKeptStatement: Kept: a year-end statement issued to the donor lists this gift. Void the statement first if the gift was a mistake.
texts.Giving_JobNotice_AcknowledgmentsBody: {0} gifts processed, {1} thank you emails sent, {2} could not be sent. Open the run for the details.
texts.Giving_JobNotice_DonorLevelsBody: {0} donors moved to a different level.
texts.Giving_JobNotice_StatementsBody: {0} donors checked, {1} statements issued, {2} batches with errors. Open the run for the details.
texts.Giving_NightlyJobs_RunFailed: The run failed. The reason is in the Error Log.
texts.Giving_NightlyJobs_TopUpSummaryFormat: Extended {0} recurring schedules. {1} chunks could not be extended and are in the Error Log.
texts.Giving_SampleData_ErrorInvalidData: The Giving sample data file could not be read. Regenerate it with scripts/data/generate-sample-data.py and deploy it again.
texts.Giving_SampleData_ResourceMissing: The Giving sample data file is not in this org, so the gifts, appeals and funds cannot be loaded. Deploy the GivingSampleData static resource and try again.
texts.Giving_Appeal_ParentCycle: That parent appeal would create a loop, because this appeal is already above it. Choose a different parent appeal, or leave Parent Appeal empty.
texts.Giving_Fund_DefaultNotSaved: The default fund could not be saved. Nothing was changed. Open BarnCRM Settings, choose Giving, and set the default fund there, or ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Giving_Fund_InUseNotDeletable: Gifts are designated to this fund, so it cannot be deleted: those gifts would point at nothing. Untick Active instead. The fund stops being offered on new gifts and keeps its history.
texts.Giving_Fund_OneDefaultAtATime: Only one fund can be the default. Save one default fund at a time, and BarnCRM will clear the flag on the previous one.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_Balanced: Balanced: the lines add up to the control total.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorBatchMissing: This batch could not be found. It may have been deleted.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorLineMissing: One of these lines no longer belongs to this batch. Reload the page and try again.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorLoadBatch: This batch could not be opened. Ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorPostFailed: The batch did not post, and no gifts were created. The batch is still here as you left it.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorRowAmount: This line needs an amount greater than zero. Money that went back is recorded as a refund on the gift, not here.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorRowDate: This line has no gift date. Give it one, or set the batch's default gift date.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorRowDonorMissing: This line has no donor. Find the person or organization that gave.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorRowPaymentMethod: This line has no payment method. Give it one, or set the batch's default payment method.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorRowPaymentNotOpen: This line pays a payment that is no longer open, or is not this donor's. Choose again in Pays, or None.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorSaveRows: Your lines could not be saved. Nothing was lost from the screen: try again in a moment.
texts.Giving_GiftEntryPays_ErrorInKind: A gift of goods cannot pay a scheduled payment. Choose None.
texts.Giving_GiftEntryPays_ErrorLoad: The donor's scheduled payments could not be loaded. You can still save the gift on its own.
texts.Giving_GiftEntryPays_ErrorNotOpen: That payment is no longer open, or is not this donor's. Nothing was saved. Choose again, or None.
texts.Giving_GiftEntryPays_OneSuggested: Chosen because it is due near the gift date and expects this amount. Choose None if the gift is not for it.
texts.Giving_GiftEntryPays_SeveralSuggested: {0} payments could be this gift, so none was chosen. Choose the right one, or None.
texts.Giving_Gift_AllocationUpdateFailed: The gift's allocation could not be updated to match the new amount, so nothing was changed. Ask your BarnCRM admin to check the error log.
texts.Giving_Gift_AllocationsMustTotal: The allocations of this gift total {0}, but the gift is {1}. The difference is {2}.
texts.Giving_Gift_AlreadyReversed: This gift is already {0}, so there is nothing left to refund or write off.
texts.Giving_Gift_AmountChangeSplit: This gift is split across more than one fund, so its amount cannot be changed here. Adjust the allocations first, then change the amount.
texts.Giving_Gift_CancelOnlyPending: Only a Pending gift can be cancelled. A gift that was received is refunded or written off instead.
texts.Giving_Gift_CancelledLogged: Gift {0} cancelled: it will not be paid.
texts.Giving_Gift_CancelledOnlyToPending: A Cancelled gift can only be set back to Pending. Set it to Pending first, then to Received when the money arrives.
texts.Giving_Gift_CannotReverseNegative: This gift already records money going back, so it cannot itself be refunded or written off. Open the original gift instead.
texts.Giving_Gift_DefaultAllocationFailed: The gift could not be allocated to the default fund, so it was not saved. Check that you can create allocations, or ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Giving_Gift_DefaultFundMissing: No default fund is set. Open BarnCRM Settings, choose Giving, and pick the fund that undesignated gifts should go to.
texts.Giving_Gift_OriginalNotFound: That gift could not be found, so nothing was changed. It may have been deleted, or you may not have access to it.
texts.Giving_Gift_OverrideCreatedWithNumber: the gift was created already carrying that receipt number
texts.Giving_Gift_ReceiptLockOverridden: A user holding the Override Receipt Lock permission lifted the receipt lock on gift {0} (receipt number {1}). What changed: {2}. Check that this correction was expected, and remove the permission from whoever holds it.
texts.Giving_Gift_ReceiptLocked: This gift has a receipt number, so its amount, date, donor and in-kind description cannot change. Void the receipt and reissue it, or record a refund.
texts.Giving_Gift_ReceiptNumberLocked: This gift's receipt number cannot be changed or cleared, because a donor is holding the receipt that carries it. Void the receipt and reissue it instead.
texts.Giving_Gift_ReceiptNumberNotIssuedByHand: BarnCRM issues a receipt number when it creates the receipt, so it cannot be typed in. Use Issue Receipt on the gift instead. A number typed here belongs to no receipt, locks the gift, and can end up on a year end statement.
texts.Giving_Gift_ReceiptedGiftNotDeletable: This gift has a receipt number, so it cannot be deleted: a donor is holding the receipt. Record a refund or a write-off instead.
texts.Giving_Gift_RefundAmountRequired: Enter how much is going back to the donor. A refund amount is always more than zero: BarnCRM records it as a negative gift for you.
texts.Giving_Gift_RefundExceedsRemaining: This refund is larger than the amount left on the gift. Check the gift's refunds: part of it may have gone back already.
texts.Giving_Gift_ReverseNeedsReceived: Only a received gift can be refunded or written off. This gift is {0}: if it is Pending and will never be paid, set its Status to Cancelled.
texts.Giving_Gift_ReversedGiftNotDeletable: This gift has a refund or write-off linked to it, so it cannot be deleted. Delete the refund first if it was recorded in error.
texts.Giving_Gift_UncancelledLogged: Gift {0} set back from Cancelled to Pending.
texts.Giving_Gift_UnexpectedError: That did not work, and nothing was changed. Try again, and if it keeps happening, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Giving_QuickGiftEntry_ErrorAmountRequire: Enter an amount greater than zero. A refund is entered from the original gift, not here.
texts.Giving_QuickGiftEntry_ErrorAppealUnavail: That appeal is not available any more. Choose another appeal.
texts.Giving_QuickGiftEntry_ErrorDateRequired: Enter the date the gift arrived.
texts.Giving_QuickGiftEntry_ErrorDonorRequired: Choose the person or organization who gave this gift.
texts.Giving_QuickGiftEntry_ErrorFairMarketVal: Fair market value cannot be negative. Leave it empty if you do not have a figure yet.
texts.Giving_QuickGiftEntry_ErrorFundUnavailab: That fund is not available any more. Choose another fund.
texts.Giving_QuickGiftEntry_ErrorInKindDescrip: Describe what was given. This text is the donor's receipt, so a gift of goods cannot be saved without it.
texts.Giving_QuickGiftEntry_ErrorLoadDefaults: The form could not load its settings. Ask your BarnCRM admin to check the default fund and default appeal in BarnCRM Settings.
texts.Giving_QuickGiftEntry_ErrorNoInput: No gift was sent to save. Enter the gift again.
texts.Giving_QuickGiftEntry_ErrorUnexpected: The gift could not be saved. Your administrator can find the details in the Error Log.
texts.Giving_QuickGiftEntry_FundNotApplied: The gift was saved, but it is already split across more than one fund, so the fund you chose was not applied. Open the gift to change its allocations.
texts.Giving_RefundGift_NoPermission: You can see this gift but not record money going back. Ask your BarnCRM admin for the Fundraising Staff role, together with the Giving Staff permission set.
texts.Giving_RefundGift_ReasonRequired: Say why the money is going back, so the next person reading this gift knows what happened.
texts.Giving_RefundGift_Success: Recorded. The gift it reverses now shows what happened.
texts.Giving_Periods_NotBeforeToday: The books can be closed through the day before yesterday at the latest. A refund or write-off is dated today, and today has to be open in every time zone.
texts.Giving_Periods_PermissionRequired: Closing a period needs the Manage BarnCRM Settings permission.
texts.Giving_Periods_ReadOnly: You can see this date. Changing it needs the Manage BarnCRM Settings permission.
texts.Giving_Periods_ReopenLogged: Books Closed Through moved back from {0} to {1}.
texts.Giving_Periods_ReopenNeedsOverride: A closed period cannot be reopened here. Moving the date back or clearing it needs the Override Posting Lock permission, granted in Setup. See Posting and Closed Periods in the admin guide.
texts.Giving_Periods_Saved: Saved. The books are closed through the date shown.
texts.Giving_Periods_UnexpectedError: Something went wrong. The details are in the Error Log.
texts.Giving_PostingCard_NotInBooks: Not in the books: Pending and in-kind gifts are in no accounting export, so this gift stays editable.
texts.Giving_Posting_AllocationLocked: This gift is in the books (posted to accounting, or dated in a closed period), so its funds and amounts to each cannot change. Record a refund instead.
texts.Giving_Posting_ClosedGiftLocked: This gift is dated in a closed accounting period (books closed through {0}), so its date, amount, donor, payment method, reference and funds cannot change and it cannot be deleted. Record a refund instead: it is dated today.
texts.Giving_Posting_ClosedPeriodNewGift: The books are closed through {0}, so a gift dated on or before that day cannot be added to them. Date the gift after {0}, or ask your BarnCRM admin.
texts.Giving_Posting_DonorLocked: Gifts from this record are posted to accounting or dated in a closed period, and the books name it as donor, so it cannot be deleted. Merge it into the right record instead.
texts.Giving_Posting_FieldsWrittenByPosting: Posted to Accounting is filled in only by marking gifts posted on the Accounting Export page, and cleared only by Unpost on the gift.
texts.Giving_Posting_NoPermission: You need the Post Gifts permission to mark gifts posted to accounting or to unpost them.
texts.Giving_Posting_NotPosted: This gift is not posted to accounting, or you cannot see it.
texts.Giving_Posting_OriginalLocked: A refund or write-off of this gift is posted to accounting or dated in a closed period, and the books name this gift as its original, so it cannot be deleted.
texts.Giving_Posting_OverrideCreated: the gift was created in the books
texts.Giving_Posting_OverrideDonorDeleted: a donor named by a locked gift was deleted
texts.Giving_Posting_OverrideEnteredBooks: the gift entered the books dated {0}
texts.Giving_Posting_OverrideRestored: the gift was restored into the books
texts.Giving_Posting_PostedGiftLocked: This gift has been posted to accounting, so its date, amount, donor, payment method, reference and funds cannot change and it cannot be deleted. Record a refund, or ask your bookkeeper to unpost it.
texts.Giving_Posting_ReasonRequired: Say why this gift is being unposted. The reason is kept in the Error Log.
texts.Giving_Posting_TooMany: Marking posted takes up to {0} gifts at a time. Choose a shorter date range, or one fund at a time.
texts.Giving_Posting_UnpostLogged: Gift {0}, posted to accounting by {2} on {3}, unposted: {1}
texts.Giving_Receipt_ActivatedMessage: This letter is now the one BarnCRM uses.
texts.Giving_Receipt_AlreadyVoid: This receipt has already been voided. Look for the receipt that replaced it.
texts.Giving_Receipt_AmountNotStated: No value stated (gift of goods or services)
texts.Giving_Receipt_EmptyTemplate: A receipt letter cannot be empty. Type the letter you want donors to read, or restore the one BarnCRM ships.
texts.Giving_Receipt_GiftAlreadyReceipted: This gift has already been receipted. To correct the receipt, void it and reissue it.
texts.Giving_Receipt_GiftNotFound: That gift could not be found, or you do not have access to it.
texts.Giving_Receipt_GiftNotReceived: A pending or cancelled gift cannot be receipted, because no money has arrived. Mark the gift Received first.
texts.Giving_Receipt_InKindAmountPhrase: the goods or services described below
texts.Giving_Receipt_InKindDescribedDefault: goods or services, described to us by the donor
texts.Giving_Receipt_InKindNotInTotal: Gifts of goods or services are listed above without a value and are not part of the total, because determining the value of donated property is the donor's responsibility.
texts.Giving_Receipt_InKindSentence: You gave the following goods or services: {0}. This organization has not placed a value on your gift; determining the value of donated property is the donor''s responsibility.
texts.Giving_Receipt_IntangibleReligious: The only goods or services provided in exchange for this contribution were intangible religious benefits.
texts.Giving_Receipt_IssuedMessage: Receipt {0} has been issued. Click View PDF beside it to open the file.
texts.Giving_Receipt_LogoUnreadable: The receipt logo file {0} could not be read, so documents are made without a logo. Check that the file exists and that people who issue receipts can see it.
texts.Giving_Receipt_NoActiveTemplate: No receipt letter is switched on for this kind of document. Open BarnCRM Settings, then Receipts, then Receipt templates, and switch one on.
texts.Giving_Receipt_NoGoods: No goods or services were provided in exchange for this contribution.
texts.Giving_Receipt_NoPermission: You do not have permission to issue receipts. Ask your BarnCRM admin for the Fundraising Staff role.
texts.Giving_Receipt_NoTemplatePermission: You do not have permission to change the receipt letters. Ask your BarnCRM admin for the BarnCRM Admin role, which carries Manage BarnCRM Settings.
texts.Giving_Receipt_NoTemplates: This org has no receipt letters. BarnCRM creates the two it ships at install, so that step did not finish. Restore them here, then edit the wording.
texts.Giving_Receipt_NotFound: That receipt could not be found, or you do not have access to it.
texts.Giving_Receipt_NothingToRender: There was nothing to put on the receipt. Check that a receipt letter is switched on.
texts.Giving_Receipt_OrganizationIncomplete: A receipt has to state who issued it. Open BarnCRM Settings, then Organization, and fill in your legal name.
texts.Giving_Receipt_QuidProQuo: In exchange for this contribution you received {0}. Our good faith estimate of the value of those goods or services is {1}. The amount of your contribution that is deductible for federal income tax purposes is limited to the excess of the amount contributed over that value, which is {2}.
texts.Giving_Receipt_ReissueNeedsGift: A year end statement is reissued by voiding it and running statements again for that donor, not from this button.
texts.Giving_Receipt_ReissuedMessage: Receipt {0} has been voided and reissued as {1}. The original file is unchanged.
texts.Giving_Receipt_RendererUnavailable: The receipt renderer chosen in settings ({0}) is not available in this org. Clear the setting to use the one BarnCRM ships.
texts.Giving_Receipt_RestoredMessage: The letters BarnCRM ships are back.
texts.Giving_Receipt_SavedMessage: Your receipt letter has been saved.
texts.Giving_Receipt_SeriesIncomplete: A receipt number needs both a receipt type and a statement year.
texts.Giving_Receipt_SeriesUnavailable: Receipt numbers are in use by another job right now. Wait a moment and try again.
texts.Giving_Receipt_StartedMessage: Year end statements are being generated. Click Refresh to see the run's progress below.
texts.Giving_Receipt_TemplateNotFound: That receipt letter could not be found. Refresh the page and try again.
texts.Giving_Receipt_UnexpectedError: That did not work. Try again, and if it keeps happening, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Giving_Receipt_UnknownRenderer: The receipt renderer chosen in settings ({0}) is not one BarnCRM offers. Clear the setting to use the one BarnCRM ships.
texts.Giving_Receipt_VoidNeedsReason: Say why this receipt is being voided. A void needs a reason and a date.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgment_EmailRunSummary: Emailed thank yous: {0} sent, {1} did not go.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgment_LetterRunFailed: The letter merge file could not be produced. The reason is in the Error Log.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgment_LetterRunSummary: Letters to merge: {0} ready to print.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgment_NoPermission: Sending thank yous needs the Send Acknowledgments permission. Ask your BarnCRM admin for the Fundraising Staff role.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgment_NoRecipient: {0} gifts in this send had nobody to email and stayed in the queue: {1}. Give the donor a contact with an email address, or write a rule that sends these by letter.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgment_RunNotFound: That acknowledgment run no longer exists.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgment_RunNotWaiting: That run is not waiting to be marked sent. Only a letter run whose file has been produced can be marked sent.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgment_SendFailedUnknown: The email could not be sent and Salesforce gave no reason.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgment_TemplatesMissing: {0} thank yous could not be sent because their rule names an email template this org does not have.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgments_EmailsStarted: The email send has started. The run below shows how it goes.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgments_LettersMarkedSent: Those letters are recorded as sent.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgments_Off: Acknowledging gifts is switched off, so nothing is joining the queue. Turn on Acknowledge gifts in BarnCRM Settings, under Giving.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgments_QueueCapped: The queue is longer than this page counts. Send what is here and the rest will be counted next time.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgments_TemplateRequired: An email rule needs an email template. Choose one from the list.
texts.Giving_AskPipeline_ErrorAction: That did not work. Try again.
texts.Giving_AskPipeline_ReadOnly: You can see asks but not change them.
texts.Giving_AskPipeline_Truncated: Showing the first {0} open asks, soonest target date first. The totals count all of them.
texts.Giving_AskReminder_Description: This donor's Next Ask Date has arrived. Make the ask, then set a new Next Ask Date and update Last Touch Date on the donor record.
texts.Giving_AskReminder_SummaryFormat: Created {0} ask reminders. {1} could not be created and are in the Error Log.
texts.Giving_Ask_ErrorAmount: Enter the pledge total, above zero.
texts.Giving_Ask_ErrorChooseLink: Choose the gift or commitment this ask produced.
texts.Giving_Ask_ErrorLoad: The ask pipeline could not be loaded. Try again. If it keeps happening, the Error Log has the details.
texts.Giving_Ask_ErrorNoDonor: This ask has no donor, so no gift or pledge can be recorded from it. Add a donor to the ask first, or record the result later.
texts.Giving_Ask_ErrorNoPermission: You can see asks but not change them. Ask your BarnCRM admin for Giving Staff access.
texts.Giving_Ask_ErrorNotFound: That ask is not available. It may have been deleted, or you may not have access to it.
texts.Giving_Ask_ErrorOutcome: Choose how the ask ended: Won, Declined or Withdrawn.
texts.Giving_Ask_ErrorPledgeSchedule: Enter how often the donor pays, how many payments, and the date of the first one.
texts.Giving_Ask_ErrorStageNotInList: "{0}" is not one of your ask stages. Choose one of: {1}.
texts.Giving_Ask_ErrorUnexpected: The ask could not be saved, and nothing was changed. The Error Log has the details.
texts.Giving_Ask_ErrorWrongDonor: That gift or commitment is from a different donor, or you cannot see it. Choose one from this ask's donor.
texts.Giving_Commitment_DeleteBlocked: This commitment cannot be deleted because a gift has been received against one of its payments. Cancel it instead.
texts.Giving_Commitment_DonorDeleteBlocked: This record is the donor of an active or paused pledge or recurring gift, so it cannot be deleted. Cancel the commitment or change its donor first. Merging a duplicate still works.
texts.Giving_Commitment_InvalidSchedule: Enter an amount, a frequency, and a start date before previewing the schedule.
texts.Giving_Commitment_NoPermission: You can see this commitment but not change it. Ask your BarnCRM admin for the Fundraising Staff role, together with the Giving Staff permission set.
texts.Giving_Commitment_NotFound: That commitment could not be found. Refresh the page and try again.
texts.Giving_Commitment_TransitionNotAllowed: That change is not allowed from the commitment's current status. Refresh the page and try again.
texts.Giving_DonorLevels_ActionFailed: BarnCRM could not read your donor levels. The details are in the Error Log.
texts.Giving_DonorLevels_NotPermitted: You need the Manage BarnCRM Settings permission to place every donor on the ladder. Ask whoever set up BarnCRM for it.
texts.Giving_DonorLevels_Off: Donor levels are off. Build your ladder here, then turn Donor levels on in BarnCRM Settings under Giving.
texts.Giving_DonorLevels_RecalculateStarted: Placing every donor on the ladder. This runs in the background and the counts below update when it finishes.
texts.Giving_DonorLevels_TurnOnFirst: Turn Donor levels on in BarnCRM Settings under Giving before placing donors on the ladder.
texts.Giving_Installment_DeleteBlocked: This payment cannot be deleted because a gift has been received against it. Mark it Skipped instead.
texts.Giving_SchedulePreview_GenerateError: The payments could not be generated. The error has been logged for your administrator.
texts.Giving_SchedulePreview_Generated: The payment schedule has been generated.
texts.Giving_SchedulePreview_LoadError: The payment schedule could not be loaded. The error has been logged for your administrator.
texts.Giving_SetupAssistant_EinPatternMessage: In the United States this is two digits, a hyphen, and seven digits, for example 12-3456789. Leave it blank if your country does not use one.
texts.Giving_SetupAssistant_SignaturePreviewAl: The signature that will be printed on your receipt letters
texts.Giving_MatchingGift_AlreadyLinked: One of these gifts is already linked to a different gift. Unlink it first, then link it here.
texts.Giving_MatchingGift_EmployeeMustBePerson: The gift being matched has to come from a person. Choose the employee's own gift, not another organization's.
texts.Giving_MatchingGift_EmployerMismatch: That gift is from someone whose employer is a different organization. Check the employer on the person's record, or clear it if you are not sure.
texts.Giving_MatchingGift_EmployerMustBeOrgani: The matching gift must come from an organization. Open the company's gift and link the employee's gift to it.
texts.Giving_MatchingGift_GiftNotFound: One of these gifts is no longer here, or you do not have access to it. Refresh the page and try again.
texts.Giving_MatchingGift_GiftNotReceived: A gift that has been refunded or written off cannot be part of a matching gift pair. Unlink the match before recording the refund, or link the replacement gift.
texts.Giving_MatchingGift_SameGift: A gift cannot match itself. Choose the other gift in the pair.
texts.Giving_PledgeReminders_ActionFailed: The pledge reminders change could not be saved. The details are in the Error Log.
texts.Giving_PledgeReminders_Disabled: Pledge reminders are turned off. An administrator turns them on in BarnCRM Settings, under Giving, once the steps and email templates are ready.
texts.Giving_PledgeReminders_LettersReady: The letter file is ready. Download it, print and post the letters, then mark them sent.
texts.Giving_PledgeReminders_NoPermission: Sending pledge reminders needs the Send Acknowledgments permission. Ask your BarnCRM admin for the Fundraising Staff role.
texts.Giving_PledgeReminders_NoRecipient: {0} scheduled payments are due an email reminder, but the commitment has no donor contact with an email address. Add a donor contact or a primary contact.
texts.Giving_PledgeReminders_Off: Pledge reminders are off, so nothing is sent, by hand or by the nightly run. Turn them on in BarnCRM Settings, under Giving, when your steps and templates are ready.
texts.Giving_PledgeReminders_RunSummary: {0} reminder emails sent, {1} letters queued, {2} could not be sent.
texts.Giving_PledgeReminders_SendStarted: The run has started. The log below fills in as it goes.
texts.Giving_PledgeReminders_TemplateNotFound: The email template {0} was not found. Edit the step on the Pledge Reminders page and choose one from the list.
texts.Giving_PledgeReminders_TemplateRequired: Choose the email template this step sends.
texts.Giving_PledgeReminders_TemplatesMissing: {0} pledge reminders could not be sent because their step names an email template that does not exist.
texts.Giving_Segments_EmailPeopleOnly: Mailchimp and Constant Contact layouts are for people. Organizations export with All Columns.
texts.Giving_Segments_ErrorLayout: Choose Mailchimp, Constant Contact or All Columns for the export.
texts.Giving_Segments_ErrorName: Give the segment a name of 80 characters or fewer.
texts.Giving_Segments_ErrorNoPermission: Donor segments are Find queries, so they need the BarnCRM Find and Export permission set. Ask your BarnCRM admin for it.
texts.Giving_Segments_ErrorNotFound: That segment was not found. It may have been deleted, or it is no longer shared with you.
texts.Giving_Segments_ErrorNotSegment: Only a saved query of people or organizations can be used as a donor segment.
texts.Giving_Segments_ErrorPeopleOnly: The Mailchimp and Constant Contact layouts are for people. Export an organization segment with All Columns.
texts.Giving_Segments_ErrorTemplate: That template is not available for the records you chose.
texts.Giving_Segments_ExportedDuplicates: Exported {0} rows. {1} repeated email addresses were written only once.
texts.Giving_Segments_LimitReached: Stopped at the export row limit of {0} rows.
texts.Giving_Segments_ListShown: Showing {0} records in the segment's own order and row limit. Change either in Find.
texts.Giving_Segments_Unexpected: Something went wrong with donor segments. The details are in the Error Log.
texts.Giving_SoftCredit_AmountOrPercent: Enter an amount or a percent, not both. BarnCRM works the other one out from the gift.
texts.Giving_SoftCredit_CustomRoleRequired: Type your own wording in Custom Role, or choose one of the roles in the list.
texts.Giving_SoftCredit_GiftRequired: A soft credit belongs to a gift. Open the gift and add the credit there.
texts.Giving_SoftCredit_OneCreditedParty: Choose one person or one organization to recognize, not both and not neither.
texts.Giving_SoftCredits_ActionFailed: That did not work. Try again, and if it keeps happening, send the newest Error Log entry to whoever supports your Salesforce.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_ErrorActionFailed: That did not work. The details are in the Error Log. Try again, and if it keeps happening, ask your BarnCRM admin to check it.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_ErrorAlreadyRunning: This plan is already running for this donor. Mark the running one complete or cancelled before starting it again, so the same tasks are not created twice.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_ErrorDonorNotVisible: You cannot see this donor, so no plan was started.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_ErrorNameRequired: A plan needs a name before it can be saved.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_ErrorNoTemplate: That plan is not available. It may have been deleted, or turned off on the Stewardship Plans page.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_ErrorNotPermitted: Changing stewardship plans needs the Manage BarnCRM Settings permission. Ask whoever administers BarnCRM for your organization.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_ErrorOneDonor: Choose one person or one organization to run this plan for, not both and not neither.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_ErrorStartFailed: BarnCRM could not start one or more stewardship plans because the plans and their templates did not line up. No tasks were created. This is a fault in BarnCRM, not something to correct in your data.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_ErrorSubjectRequired: A step needs a subject, because that is the line the assignee reads in their task list.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_ReadOnlyNotice: You can read the plans here. Changing them needs the Manage BarnCRM Settings permission.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_RunningNotice: Editing a plan changes what starts next. Plans already running keep the tasks they laid out, because those tasks are already in people's lists and weekly plans.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_StartLoadFailed: The stewardship plans could not be read. Close this window and try again.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_StartNoPermission: You can see stewardship plans but not start one. Ask your BarnCRM admin for the Fundraising Staff role, together with the Giving Staff permission set.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_StartNone: No stewardship plan is turned on. An administrator writes plans and turns them on in BarnCRM Settings, Giving, Stewardship plans.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_StartSuccess: The plan has started. Its tasks are in the task lists of the people they are assigned to.
texts.Giving_TributeNotification_NoRecipient: Nobody is recorded as the person to notify, so there is no letter to send. Add a notification recipient, or a name and address, on the tribute.
texts.Giving_TributeNotification_NotFound: That tribute is no longer here, or you do not have access to it. Refresh the page and try again.
texts.Giving_Tribute_DeceasedHonoreeNotified: This gift is in memory of the person you have chosen to notify. Choose a family member or friend as the notification recipient.
texts.Giving_Tribute_HonoreeRequired: Say who this gift honors: type the name the donor gave, or choose a person already in your database.
texts.Giving_Tribute_OnePerGift: This gift already has a tribute. Edit the one that is there, or split the gift.
